in_marathi.name: Sarang
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bond of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarang हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘saranga’, Sarang means 'a lover of the heart', 'a bond of love', or 'a melodious song'. This name is derived from the word ‘sarang’, meaning 'a stringed musical instrument', and symbolizes love, music, and nature.
